# KEY-20261109-017 原片动效与局部修复观察

适用该原片。历史五个语种的成片记录指出建筑、头发和衣服区域存在修复痕迹，以及短暂的进场、UI 和引文残影。复做时应检查原片、底片、译片整幅对照和进退场边界。

独立的两秒 Wan 试验去除了抽查位置的标题和水印，但第59帧的鞋、脚及溅水姿态发生变化。整体结果未采用。对该源应先核对主体运动及文字外区域，再确定可用局部。

西语、荷语、葡语、泰语历史记录显示相连描边使自动分组形成整标题淡入。明确划分短语或行区域后，编码帧2–11的实际进场有所改善，仍有描边尖端裁切适配。

历史低码率成片的抽查文字可读，音频比特流及解码对照一致，纹理损失仍存在。各语言的发音、字体、具体运动与质量需独立核验。泰语历史听审与识别分歧、费用和各语种成片哈希见 evidence:observations。

adopted_parts: Single-source nl observation: actual complete source-style scene copy and genuine dub were delivered with visible architectural/hair/clothing repair traces and short source-entry/UI/quote residues. Transparent lettering and native frame count did not prove a natural clean background or fine motion. Low-bitrate encoding preserved readable inspected copy and identical AAC/full decoded PCM/separate head-tail; texture loss remained. Scope is this source and exact locale, one independent source; no company, pristine-quality or native-motion acceptance. Connected artwork outlines produced one automatic component and an actual whole-title fade; explicit phrase/line regions corrected the observed2..11-frame entry, with clipped outline-tip adaptation disclosed. Measure actual encoded entry instead of trusting segmentation metadata.
